correctness.rationale: The published maximal compact-history theorem yields the exact pointwise polynomial (1), independently checked for 17,368 source words. Binary delayed differences are i.i.d. fair bits. Centering the polynomial, explicit linear coefficients and pair orthogonality give the variance. The quadratic remainder has variance O(n²), while the linear independent-sum term has variance asymptotic n³/16; this proves the Gaussian limit by CLT and Slutsky. n=4 is correctly included.
